# Jupiter Industries

> Jupiter Industries is a premier Indian manufacturer of heavy-duty industrial brick, block, and concrete machinery. Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, the company provides end-to-end turnkey machinery solutions, pan-India installation, on-site operator training, and robust after-sales engineering support with 35+ years of engineering experience and 500+ successful installations.

## Core Machinery Catalog

- [Fly Ash Brick Machines](https://jupitergroups.in/products/fly-ash-brick-machine): High-tonnage hydraulic and rotary pressing machines designed for consistent, high-density fly ash brick manufacturing with minimal cement consumption.
- [Hollow & Solid Block Machines](https://jupitergroups.in/products/hollow-and-solid-block-machine): Heavy-duty concrete block making machines engineered for producing hollow blocks, solid building blocks, and cellular lightweight masonry units.
- [Interlocking Block Making Machines](https://jupitergroups.in/products/inter-block-making-machine): Precision hydraulic machines engineered for soil-cement, fly ash, and composite interlocking blocks that reduce mortar requirements in construction.
- [Paver Block Making Machines](https://jupitergroups.in/products/paver-block-machine): Heavy vibro-compaction and hydraulic paver plants producing zigzag, uni-paver, cobblestone, and dual-layer colored reflective paving blocks for driveways, pedestrian walkways, and industrial ports.
- [Concrete Batching Plants](https://jupitergroups.in/products/batching-plant): Automated concrete mixing and aggregate batching systems with precision load-cell weighing for uniform concrete consistency and high hourly throughput.
- [Storage Silos](https://jupitergroups.in/products/storage-silo): Bolted and welded industrial vertical silos for dry bulk storage of cement, fly ash, and mineral powders equipped with dust collectors, safety relief valves, and screw conveyors.
- [Machine Spares & Tooling](https://jupitergroups.in/products/machine-spares): Hardened steel molds, hydraulic valves, high-pressure cylinders, pan mixer wear liners, conveyor rollers, and electrical control panels.

## Key Capabilities & Engineering USPs

- Turnkey Pan-India Delivery & Erection: Full foundation guidance, plant layout design, installation, and commissioning anywhere in India.
- High Structural Integrity: Fabricated using prime-grade high-tensile steel plates, automated submerged-arc welding, and stress-relieved frames.
- Automation & PLC Controls: Equipped with reliable PLC touchscreens, automatic pallet feeding, sensorized stacking, and electronic batch counters.
- 35+ Years Track Record: Over five decades of collective domain expertise and 500+ operational manufacturing plants.
